options.name: access_token_lifetime
options.description: Validity duration for JWT access tokens. Specify as [DD [HH:[MM:]]]ss (optional filter)

options.name: auto_logout_timeout
options.description: Inactivity period for auto logout (optional filter)

options.name: build
options.description: The current VMS build running on the cluster. (optional filter)

options.name: capacity_base_10
options.description:
True if capacity properties are formatted in base 10. False if capacity properties are formatted in base 2
(optional filter)

options.name: capacity_usable
options.description:
Toggles between showing usable capacity (true, default) or physical capacity (false) in the capacity card on the
VMS web UI dashboard (optional filter)

options.name: created
options.description: Date and time of creation (optional filter)

options.name: degraded_reason
options.description: The reason for VMS degraded state (optional filter)

options.description: True if management HA is disabled (optional filter)

options.description: True if VMS metrics collection is disabled (optional filter)

options.description: Enable GUI timeout based on inactivity (optional filter)

options.name: guid
options.description: Filter by guid (optional filter)

options.description: The ID of the VMS object. (optional filter)

The bond interface IP for the cluster's internal data network, on the current management CNode, the CNode hosting
VMS (optional filter)

options.description: The IP of the management CNode on one of the cluster's internal data networks. (optional filter)

options.name: ipv6_support
options.description: Parameter that controls visibility of ipv6 fields for VIP Pools (optional filter)

options.name: login_banner

options.name: max_api_tokens_per_user

options.name: mgmt_data_vip_vlan
options.description: Management Data Interface VLAN for L3 networks (optional filter)

options.name: mgmt_inner_vip
options.description: A virtual IP on the internal network used for mounting the VMS database. (optional filter)

options.name: mgmt_inner_vip_cnode
options.description:
The CNode currently hosting virtual IP on the internal network used for mounting the VMS database
(mgmt_inner_vip). (optional filter)

options.name: mgmt_ip
options.description: The external management IP of the management CNode, the CNode currently hosting VMS (optional filter)

options.name: mgmt_vip
options.description:
Management virtual IP (IPv4). A single virtual IP configured on the management interfaces on all CNodes. VAST
Management System (VMS) listens on this IP. It is used to access the VMS interfaces. (optional filter)

options.name: mgmt_vip_ipv6
options.description:
Management virtual IP (IPv6). A single virtual IP configured on the management interfaces on all CNodes. VAST
Management System (VMS) listens on this IP. It is used to access the VMS interfaces. (optional filter)

options.name: min_pwd_length
options.description: Minimum password length for new VMS managers. Default: 8 (optional filter)

options.name: min_qos_supported
options.description: Minimum QoS supported (optional filter)

options.name: min_tls_version
options.description: Minimum TLS version supported by VMS. The default is 1.2. (optional filter)

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the VMS (optional filter)

options.name: performance_base_10
options.description:
True if performance properties are formatted in base 10. False if performance properties are formatted in base 2
(optional filter)

options.name: refresh_token_lifetime
options.description: Validity duration for JWT refresh tokens. Specify as [DD [HH:[MM:]]]ss (optional filter)

options.name: ssl_certificate
options.description: The SSL Certificate file content, including the BEGIN CERTIFICATE and END CERTIFICATE lines (optional filter)

options.name: ssl_keyfile
options.description: The SSL private key file content, include the BEGIN PRIVATE KEY and END PRIVATE KEY lines (optional filter)

options.name: ssl_port
options.description: The SSL port through which VMS is accessed. (optional filter)

options.name: state
options.description: The state of VMS. (optional filter)

options.name: sw_version
options.description: The current VMS software version running on the cluster. (optional filter)

options.description: Parameter that controls everything related to database (optional filter)

options.name: title
options.description: VMS name (optional filter)

options.description: The total licensed capacity, which is the sum of capacity licensed by all active licenses (optional filter)

options.name: total_remaining_capacity
options.description: The amount of licensed capacity that remains available for use. (optional filter)

options.name: total_usage_capacity_percentage
options.description: The percentage of total licensed capacity that is in use. (optional filter)
